issue.title: Reject issue-refinement path expansion
issue.body:
## Required Task Fields

```yaml
lane: validation_tooling
intelligence_level: frontier
reason: "Fixture keeps issue scope narrower than the packet."
durable_source_of_truth: "GitHub issue #1002"
objective: "Reject packet path expansion."
plan:
  - compare packet with issue
checklist:
  - command fails
acceptance_sheet:
  - exact expansion code is reported
allowed_paths:
  - scripts/asgk.py
expected_output:
  - task packet check fails
non_goals:
  - no compact governance default
stop_conditions:
  - expansion is accepted
rollback_expectations:
  - revert fixture
context_read_set:
  - AGENTS.md
  - scripts/asgk.py
project_specific_validation:
  - python3 scripts/asgk.py task-packet-check
```
